text.tspan: Figure 5.1 PERT chart (activity on node) with the critical path
A Requirements elicitation and handout analysis
B System, database and UI design
C Backend foundation and authentication (incl. Google)
D Listings, photos, search, filters and subject catalogue
E Purchase requests, negotiation, messaging, notifications
F Reporting, moderation, admin dashboard, audit log
G Frontend pages, responsive layout, themes
H Example marketplace data and automated sellers
I Integration, system and regression testing
J Project documentation (SRS, design, test report)
K Evaluation readiness: build, setup checks, demo data
Critical path (red): A → B → C → D → E → H → I → J → K, 41.51 working days. Durations are PERT estimates, not recorded effort.
